source_notes.research_scope: Belfast-only architecture and built-environment candidate events, researched as a temporary vetting pass for roughly 2008-2026 coverage.
source_notes.primary_source: Belfast City Council current planning applications public-notice page, accessed 2026-05-18.
source_notes.method: Compared distinctive site names, address strings and application IDs against data/manual_drops/architecture_milestones/architecture_milestones_2008_2026.json before adding each candidate.
source_notes.date_basis_note: Most candidates are application advertisement dates, not observed construction, approval, completion or opening dates. They should be labelled as proposed/open-for-comment if promoted into the corpus.
source_notes.geocoding_note: Coordinates are approximate address or street points where provided. Entries with uncertain location use null coordinates and a geocode note rather than inferred precision.
source_notes.licensing_note: This file stores factual metadata and URLs only. Belfast City Council page terms and any linked planning-portal documents should be reviewed before redistributing richer extracts or drawings.
source_notes.limitations: The council current-applications page is a rolling public-notice page and older notices may disappear from the live page. Before ingestion, verify application IDs, decisions, plans and any listed-building/conservation details in the official planning portal or committee papers.
